input.quote: (a) EXCEPT WITH RESPECT TO THE PARTIES' LIABILITY FOR INDEMNIFICATION, OR LIABILITY FOR BREACH OF CONFIDENTIALITY, NEITHER PARTY SHALL BE LIABLE FOR ANY CONSEQUENTIAL, INCIDENTAL, INDIRECT, PUNITIVE, SPECIAL OR OTHER SIMILAR DAMAGES
input.rationale: Section 7 is the only limitation-of-liability provision and contains solely a mutual exclusion of consequential/indirect damages (with carve-outs for indemnification and confidentiality). No monetary cap exists anywhere in the Agreement: searches for "exceed" and "aggregate" return no cap language, and the indemnity (§10) and warranty (§9) provisions contain none. Both Parties' direct liability is therefore unlimited, which fails even the fallback position (mutual cap of 12 months' fees). The revenue-share payment structure in §5 (Kubient pays Customer a share of revenue; Customer pays no fees) means a fees-based cap alone would be illusory, so we add the USD 1,000,000 floor from the preferred position and keep indemnification, confidentiality/data protection, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and IP infringement uncapped as Excluded Claims, mirroring the carve-outs already in §7(a).

proposal.summary: Add a mutual liability cap (greater of 12 months' amounts paid/payable and USD 1,000,000) with uncapped Excluded Claims to Section 7.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual cap on liability at the greater of twelve (12) months' amounts paid or payable between the Parties and USD 1,000,000, since Section 7 currently excludes consequential damages but leaves both Parties' direct liability entirely uncapped; the fixed floor is needed because Customer pays no fees under the revenue-share model. Indemnification, confidentiality, data protection and security, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud and infringement of the other Party's IP sit outside the cap, consistent with the carve-outs already in Section 7(a).

ops.text: (b) Except with respect to Excluded Claims, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the greater of (i) the aggregate amounts paid or payable between the Parties under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months immediately preceding the event giving rise to the claim and (ii) USD 1,000,000. "Excluded Claims" means a Party's breach of its confidentiality, data protection or security obligations, its indemnification obligations, its gross negligence, wilful misconduct or fraud, and its infringement of the other Party's intellectual property rights, none of which shall be subject to the foregoing limitation.
